jobs.title: Director, Public & Alternative Investments, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand.

The Team

CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

Accountabilities

Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Engineering

We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. jobs.description:
Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

15+ years of telecommunications experience spanning deep technical roles and positions with product, customer, or business leadership accountability.

Customer-facing experience relating to network consultancy services or similar.

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.

Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

A leader in private medicine in Quebec, the Lacroix Medical Group comprises three rapidly growing divisions:

Medical Clinics

OUR MISSION

To be the benchmark in private healthcare.

OUR VALUES

Passion | Respect | Integrity | Commitment | Innovation.

The Mandate

In a context of sustained growth and transformation of its activities, Lacroix Medical Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology who will actively contribute to the organization's technological evolution.

Reporting directly to the President and CEO, the Director of IT plays a strategic role across the entire network. They are responsible for defining, structuring, and developing the IT function to effectively support the organization's operations, growth, and ambitions.

They provide leadership for technology strategy, infrastructure, business systems, cybersecurity, data governance, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence.

He is also responsible for the performance of his team and the organization's technology partner ecosystem. This role is for an experienced, business-oriented, and results-driven IT leader who can combine strategic vision with excellent execution. Your Key Responsibilities IT Strategy and Governance: Define and deploy the IT vision and master plan in line with the strategic, operational, and financial priorities of Groupe médical Lacroix. Advise senior management on investments, risks, and key technological choices.

Performance and Business Continuity

Ensure the performance, robustness, and high availability of the infrastructure and technology platforms essential to the network's medical and administrative activities, including ERP, CRM, DME, LIS, SaaS, and cloud environments.

Digital Transformation, Data, and Artificial Intelligence

Identify and prioritize initiatives to transform the organization through technology, data valorization, automation, and artificial intelligence. Lead major technology projects and ensure their effective integration into operations.

Cybersecurity and Risk Management

Maintain high standards in cybersecurity, information protection, redundancy, and business continuity in an environment where system availability and the protection of medical data are critical.

Leadership and Organizational Performance

Lead and develop a competent, autonomous, and accountable IT team. Establish clear objectives and performance indicators, ensure rigorous budget management, and optimize the contribution of suppliers, consultants, and technology partners.

An Executive Role Close to Operations

At Lacroix Medical Group, technology must meet the realities on the ground.

The IT Director will therefore need to maintain close contact with the various business units and network teams to understand their needs, anticipate challenges, and ensure that technological solutions contribute concretely to operational performance and service quality.

The position consequently requires excellent mobility. The successful candidate will be required to travel regularly throughout the Lacroix network in Quebec to meet with teams, support projects, and remain connected to the operational realities of the various facilities.

This on-the-ground presence is an essential component of the role and not an occasional responsibility.

The mandate expressly includes regular visits to service points.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for an experienced manager with a strong business acumen and excellent technological expertise, recognized for their leadership, judgment, and ability to drive organizational growth.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

A bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field;
15 to 20 years of experience in information technology, including a minimum of 5 years in a management role;
Mastery of software architecture and project management;
A solid understanding of multi-site and cloud infrastructures;
Good knowledge of SaaS environments and major business platforms: ERP, CRM, financial systems, telephony, Microsoft 365, and others;
A thorough understanding of the issues cybersecurity, data governance and valorization, and artificial intelligence;
Proven experience in team management and development;
Recognized leadership in transformation and change management;
Ability to prioritize, make decisions, and manage effectively in a complex and evolving environment;
Excellent business acumen and the ability to communicate technological issues to senior management;
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken;
A valid driver's license, a vehicle, and significant availability for regular travel throughout the network.

The Leader Profile We Are Looking For

Beyond technological expertise, we are looking for someone who stands out for their ability to mobilize, structure, and deliver.

A positive and committed leader with a strong sense of Accountability, the ability to build high-performing teams, manage rigorously, challenge the status quo, and transform technological challenges into concrete solutions for the business. The IT Director must be equally comfortable discussing strategy with senior management and understanding the challenges faced by teams in the field.
